mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS review_id, r.content, r.updated_at AS review_updated_at FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN review_embeddings e ON e.review_id = r.id WHERE e.review_id IS NULL OR e.updated_at < r.updated_at OR e.embedder_version <> #{embedderVersion} ORDER BY r.updated_at ASC, r.id ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO review_embeddings (review_id, embedding, embedder_version, updated_at) VALUES
( #{row.reviewId}, #{row.embedding, typeHandler=com.ssafy.gourming.typehandler.FloatArrayJsonTypeHandler}, #{row.embedderVersion}, COALESCE(#{row.updatedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE embedding = VALUES(embedding), embedder_version = VALUES(embedder_version), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.place_id FROM reviews r JOIN review_embeddings e ON e.review_id = r.id WHERE e.embedder_version = #{embedderVersion} ORDER BY r.place_id

SELECT e.review_id, e.embedding, e.embedder_version, e.updated_at FROM review_embeddings e JOIN reviews r ON r.id = e.review_id WHERE r.place_id = #{placeId} AND e.embedder_version = #{embedderVersion}

SELECT p.id FROM places p LEFT JOIN place_embeddings pe ON pe.place_id = p.id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviews r WHERE r.place_id = p.id) AND ( pe.place_id IS NULL OR pe.embedder_version <> #{embedderVersion} OR pe.source <> 'CATEGORY' ) ORDER BY p.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_embeddings (place_id, embedding, source, review_count, embedder_version, updated_at) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{embedding, typeHandler=com.ssafy.gourming.typehandler.FloatArrayJsonTypeHandler}, #{source}, #{reviewCount}, #{embedderVersion}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE embedding = VALUES(embedding), source = VALUES(source), review_count = VALUES(review_count), embedder_version = VALUES(embedder_version), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
